meta.scope: Philippines Batch 5 — Power/energy mix, social protection (4Ps), and ASEAN/RCEP architecture.

candidates.title: Philippine Power Statistics (generation, capacity, consumption)
candidates.description: Official statistics on installed and dependable capacity, gross generation by technology, electricity sales and consumption, and system peak demand. Coal remains the largest single source; natural gas, geothermal, hydro, solar, wind and oil-based plants complete the mix. Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao grids reported separately.
referenced_by: National accounts and industrial energy analysis
candidates.notes: Core power-system statistical product. Coal-dominant with significant renewable (especially geothermal) contribution.

candidates.title: Electricity generation and capacity mix by technology
candidates.description: Breakdown of installed/dependable capacity and generation by fuel/technology — coal, natural gas, oil-based, geothermal, hydro, solar, wind, biomass, storage. Highlights both the coal lock-in and the sizeable indigenous geothermal resource.

candidates.title: Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) statistics
candidates.publisher: Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD)
candidates.description: Official performance and coverage statistics for the national conditional cash-transfer and human-capital program. Tracks household beneficiaries, self-sufficiency exits, education and health outcomes of monitored children.
candidates.notes: Flagship social-protection node. Institutionalised by RA 11310.

candidates.title: Broader social-protection and human-capital programme framing
candidates.description: Policy and statistical framing of the wider social-protection system that centres 4Ps while encompassing complementary programmes for food security, health and shock response.

candidates.title: ASEAN economic cooperation framework (Philippine participation)
candidates.publisher: ASEAN / Department of Trade and Industry
candidates.description: Philippine participation in the ASEAN economic community and related cooperation frameworks. Continuously cited in regional trade, investment and policy analysis.

candidates.title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) participation
candidates.description: Philippine membership in RCEP — the mega-FTA linking ASEAN with China, Japan, Korea, Australia and New Zealand. Provides preferential market access and rules that interact with electronics and other supply-chain trade.

candidates.title: Philippines energy–social-protection–ASEAN densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from DOE, DSWD and DTI/ASEAN sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Philippine Power Statistics, electricity generation/capacity mix, 4Ps programme statistics, broader social-protection framing, ASEAN cooperation and RCEP participation into a coherent energy, welfare and regional-architecture layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
